Vendored Jansson 2.15.1
=======================

Locked dependency for the Capsid Host configuration validator. This tree is
the authoritative source; the build never downloads or fetches Jansson at
configure time.

Provenance
----------

- Upstream:   https://github.com/akheron/jansson
- Locked tag: v2.15.1
- Archive:    https://github.com/akheron/jansson/archive/refs/tags/v2.15.1.tar.gz
- SHA-256:    dbf95cb0af903f4fb8b61507d96b45b67db7d1479688ede352e1d571394d06f7

Copied verbatim from the archive, unmodified:

- LICENSE
- src/*.c, src/*.h, src/jansson.def
- cmake/jansson_private_config.h.cmake (upstream CMake config template)
- cmake/jansson_config.h.cmake, EXCEPT the documented security deviation
  below (JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH 2048 -> 64)

Verification: extract the archive above and diff vendor/jansson/src against
jansson-2.15.1/src; they must be identical. For the CMake config templates,
only the JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH value in cmake/jansson_config.h.cmake may
differ from upstream.

Deliberate deviations from the upstream build
---------------------------------------------

- JANSSON_VERSION is defined as "2.15.1". Upstream CMakeLists.txt line 42
  sets "4.15.1" (a packaging bug; configure.ac declares 2.15.1), which would
  make jansson_version_str() report the wrong version.
- JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH in cmake/jansson_config.h.cmake is tightened from
  the upstream 2048 to 64, matching capsid::host::kMaxConfigNesting
  (src/host/config.h). This bounds parser recursion on the Host
  configuration front end; exceeding the depth fails parsing with
  json_error_stack_overflow, which the Host maps to kResourceLimit. The
  generated jansson_config.h is produced from this modified template at
  configure time, so the change is only effective after reconfiguring.
- USE_DTOA is off (the upstream default); dtoa.c is vendored but not built.
- MSVC atomic tier: upstream jansson.h only has the GCC/Clang builtin
  families for refcounting. A guarded `_MSC_VER` tier using the Win32
  `_InterlockedIncrement64`/`_InterlockedDecrement64` intrinsics was added
  after the __sync tier, and the CMakeLists sets both builtin macros to 0
  on MSVC so that tier is selected. Refcount semantics (atomic inc/dec)
  are unchanged.
- Only the static library target `capsid_jansson` is created; no install, no
  docs, no examples, no tests.
- The generated configuration headers are produced from the vendored CMake
  templates with the values the upstream CMake build would detect on the
  supported platforms (Linux/macOS, Clang/GCC):
  JSON_INT_T "long long", json_strtoint strtoll, JSON_INTEGER_FORMAT "lld",
  JSON_INLINE inline, JSON_HAVE_ATOMIC_BUILTINS 1,
  JSON_HAVE_SYNC_BUILTINS 1, HAVE_* header/function macros 1,
  WORDS_BIGENDIAN undef, USE_URANDOM 1, JANSSON_INITIAL_HASHTABLE_ORDER 3.
  JSON_PARSER_MAX_DEPTH is 64 (Capsid security deviation; upstream value is
  2048), bounding parse recursion.

Build contract
--------------

- Include only from cmake/build_host.cmake, i.e. only when
  CAPSID_BUILD_HOST=ON.
- The vendored C sources are compiled with the project's C11 baseline and
  are intentionally NOT built with -Werror: vendor sources must not block
  the Host on upstream compiler warnings.
- capsid_host_core links capsid_jansson PRIVATE; jansson symbols never
  become part of the public ABI.

Upgrade checklist
-----------------

1. Replace vendor/jansson/src and cmake templates from the new archive.
2. Update this file (tag, SHA-256) before committing.
3. Re-run the host config contract tests and the Host sanitizer jobs.
4. Verify jansson_version_str() reports the locked version.
